classification.difficultyReason: Students translate tunnel width and concrete thickness into inner and outer radii, then subtract semicylinder volumes to find the concrete required.

content.prompt:
Enzo is building a 20 m long tunnel that has a 6 m wide semicircle for a cross section.
The tunnel is to be built using concrete that needs to be 1 m thick.
How many cubic metres of concrete does Enzo need to build the tunnel, correct to 3 d.p.?

spec.description: Open semicircular tunnel shell, with distinct inner and outer arcs and no floor slab. Internal diameter 6 m, radial thickness 1 m, longitudinal length 20 m. Source lavender fill omitted; shell boundaries preserve the concrete region.
spec.mathematics: Inner radius 3 m, outer radius 4 m, length 20 m. Concrete is the difference between two semicylinders.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source dimensions are labelled.
